snippet.title: Atomfall - Wicked Isle DLC Trailer | Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, PC, PS5 & PS4
snippet.description:
Dare you visit the dark and lonely waters of the Wicked Isle?

Atomfall - Wicked Isle DLC is Included in the Deluxe Edition and in the Deluxe Upgrade Pack and available to purchase separately when released, Wicked Isle is available from June 3rd on Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One, Windows PC and PC via Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4. 

Deluxe Edition Upgrade: http://reb.to/AtomfallUpgradeNow

Deluxe Upgrade Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3607720/Atomfall_Deluxe_Upgrade/
Deluxe Upgrade PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/product/UP4363-PPSA15493_00-ATOMFALLDELUXEUP
Deluxe Upgrade Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-GB/games/store/atomfall-deluxe-upgrade/9PMX3J2XC1W4/0010
Deluxe Upgrade Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/atomfall--deluxe-upgrade-pack

Game Pass subscribers will benefit from a 10% discount.
Xbox Game Pass Upgrade Now: http://reb.to/AtomfallXboxUpgrade

Drawing on the folk horror elements of the game for inspiration, the story expansion is set on Midsummer Island. To cross to the island players must talk to the boat-keeper who can be found on the jetty in Wyndham Village. He will give you information about the island as well as your first Lead. 

Atomfall is OUT NOW and is now available to buy. Atomfall is out on Game Pass, Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One, Windows PC and PC via Steam and Epic Games Store. Atomfall will also release on PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 4.

Buy Atomfall here: http://reb.to/YTAtomfallOutNow

Buy on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/801800/Atomfall/
Buy on PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/product/UP4363-PPSA15493_00-ATOMFALLBASEGAME
Buy on Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-gb/games/store/atomfall/9nc4wdl5kzbl
Buy on Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/atomfall
